# FreeBrain

> FreeBrain is a non-profit movement therapy platform for people living with neurological conditions. All tools are free to use.

FreeBrain offers free, research-backed movement therapy tools: a personalized movement planner, a library of guided movements, and playful movement challenges. Content is written for patients, caregivers and clinicians, and is grounded in published research on exercise and neuroplasticity.

We do not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified clinician before starting a new exercise program.

## Key pages

- [Movement Planner](https://www.freethebrains.com/movement-planner): Build a personalized 10-minute movement plan for Parkinson's disease, MS, stroke recovery and other neurological conditions.
- [Movement Library](https://www.freethebrains.com/movements): Browse guided movements with videos, safety tiers and filters for mobility level and time available.
- [Lisbon Pilot](https://www.freethebrains.com/lisbon-pilot): A research pilot running in Lisbon — eligibility, what participants do, and how to sign up.
- [Bunny Challenge](https://www.freethebrains.com/bunny-challenge): A camera-based movement game that turns hand and arm exercises into a short daily challenge.
- [Team](https://www.freethebrains.com/team): Founders, advisors and partners behind FreeBrain.
- [Terms & Services](https://www.freethebrains.com/terms): Terms of service, privacy and medical disclaimer.

## Optional
